map.由均值与标准差求变异系数: Coefficient of Variation from Mean and Standard Deviation
map.输入均值 μ 与标准差 σ，求变异系数。: Enter the mean μ and standard deviation σ to get the coefficient of variation.
map.📖 查看「由均值与标准差求变异系数使用指南」: 📖 View the "Coefficient of Variation from Mean and Standard Deviation User Guide"
map.无量纲，便于跨量纲比较离散度。: Dimensionless, so dispersion can be compared across units.
map.CV=σ/μ×100%，无量纲比较离散度。: CV=σ/μ×100%, a dimensionless measure of dispersion.
map.不同量纲或均值差异大的数据可比性。: Comparability across data with different units or very different means.
map.CV<10% 稳定、10%–30% 中等、>30% 波动大。: CV below 10% is stable, 10%-30% moderate and above 30% highly variable.
map.A 组 μ=100、σ=15 → CV=15%；B 组 μ=50、σ=12 →: Group A with μ=100, σ=15 gives CV=15%; group B with μ=50, σ=12 gives CV=24%. B fluctuates more in relative terms even though its σ is smaller.
map.基金年化收益 8%、σ=12% → CV=150%；低收益高波动需谨慎。: A fund returning 8% a year with σ=12% has CV=150%; low return with high volatility calls for caution.
map.有量纲，除以均值消去量纲，使不同单位（身高 cm vs 重量 kg）的离散度可横: carries units, and dividing by the mean removes them, so dispersion can be compared across variables such as height in cm and weight in kg.
map.均值接近 0 时？: What if the mean is close to 0?
map.CV 会失真甚至发散，此时不宜用 CV，改用绝对离散度指标。: CV becomes distorted or even diverges, so do not use it then; switch to an absolute measure of dispersion.
